title: Managed eligibility
hero: Managed mode is an explicit choice
ui: Eligible device info; OEM/API; ownership status; setup caveat
rule: No remote conversion of ordinary installed app to device owner
error: Non-resettable device; unsupported API; enrollment failed
accept: STANDARD remains usable and managed features disabled.

title: Device provenance and handoff
hero: Where did this observation come from?
ui: Phone/tablet/watch source; observed times; disagreement states
rule: Device location never automatically equals child's body
error: Stale watch; contradictory devices; device lost
accept: Conflict visible; cannot merge sources as certainty.

title: Guardian invitation
hero: Invite approved adult to one child
ui: Recipient verification; scope checkboxes; expiry and privacy disclosure
api: Guardian invitation service and child-scoped grant issuance
rule: Owner-only candidate; adult verification, custody disputes OPEN
error: Expired token; unverified adult; too broad scope
accept: No granted access until accepted and verified.

title: Guardian grant detail
hero: Exactly what can this adult do?
ui: Child; scopes; grant time; last access; revoke
api: Guardian grant API and revocation epoch + SSE invalidate
rule: Family membership alone grants no child read
error: Already revoked; stale cache; shared device

title: Access ledger
ui: Who; child scope; event; time; export and grant actions
api: Redacted audit events per retention policy
rule: No raw precise child coordinates, tokens or identity docs in logs

title: Retention settings
hero: Know how long categories are retained
ui: Raw GPS/history/usage/audit/backup categories and signed policy
api: Retention policy registry; erase task status
error: Policy missing; legal hold; export conflict
accept: No invented policy promises; legal signoff required.

title: Data access/export
ui: Choose child and category; preview metadata; export destination
api: Scoped export workflow, audit, expiration; redact defaults
rule: Verify authority, minimize data and avoid unsafe share links
error: Expired link; incomplete historical data; access denied
accept: Download expires; event audited without leaking payload.

title: Account and child deletion
ui: Select child/account; explain backup delay; subscription separate
api: Deletion job + tombstone; revoke epochs; offline queue cutoff
rule: Keep data-subject rights available after plan expires
error: Partial delete; pending provider copy; backup restore
accept: Erasure cannot be undone by later restored database.

title: Support diagnostics
ui: Scope preview; device state; errors; no raw GPS by default
api: Support diagnostic exporter with 24-hour candidate expiry
rule: Only parent-authorized minimal packet; no tokens/private keys
error: No consent; redaction failure; upload missing
accept: Sentinel private data absent from export and logs.

title: Capability before purchase
hero: Know exactly what your phone supports
ui: STANDARD vs MANAGED; OS restrictions; legal feature flags
api: Backend device capability and legal-purpose entitlement gating
rule: Do not sell unavailable media, usage or managed controls
error: Feature UNKNOWN; permission denied; old API
accept: Unsupported clearly labeled before Play checkout.

title: Family seats
hero: One seat for each enrolled child
ui: Capacity N; assigned children; add/remove; guardians free
api: Play product family_children_N + backend verified seats
rule: Owner approves every capacity change and Play price

title: Checkout review
hero: Review final amount in Google Play
ui: Term; N seats; auto-renew; total; tax caveat
api: BillingClient ProductDetails + purchase token to Drogon
rule: ₹50/month / ₹500/year proposed, not guaranteed final inclusive price
error: Payment pending; canceled; wrong Play account
accept: No entitlement until verified PURCHASED token.

title: Subscription status
hero: Payment and seat access remain distinct
ui: ACTIVE; PENDING; GRACE; HOLD; expiry; renewal
api: Play subscriptionsv2 + RTDN revalidation & order ledger
rule: Data privacy and deletion never blocked by payment state
error: Refund; chargeback; token replay; stale RTDN
accept: No double seats or fake renewal completion.

title: Notification and quiet hours
ui: Category; duplicate window; quiet hours; recipients
api: Verified per-family alert preference + server dedupe
rule: Do not silence opted SOS escalation as ordinary alert
error: Timezone change; missed alert; revoked recipient
accept: High priority and low priority separately handled.

title: Battery/coverage profiles
hero: Performance depends on device and OS
ui: Normal/Eco; GPS age; coverage metric; energy test info
api: Versioned adaptive sampling settings and signed capability ack
rule: Measured values only; no guaranteed 50% savings
error: OS rejects update; low battery; no GPS
accept: Last observation age stays explicit in Eco mode.

title: Server outage/recovery
ui: Last observed time; service status; retry and safe contact help
api: API health, stale cached record, retry/recovery status
rule: Single VM is not highly available; no SOS guarantee
accept: Shows UNAVAILABLE instead of invented online status.

title: Permission-change notice
ui: Lost location/notif privilege; observed time; child guide
api: Latest signed child capabilities with revision timestamp
rule: Do not infer user denial from silent device
error: No fresh capability; app uninstalled; OS_CHANGED
accept: Unknown differs from DENIED, parent can recheck.

title: Cancel/manage subscription
hero: Stop renewal without hiding privacy rights
ui: Renewal date; access to expiry; cancel; receipts
api: Deep link to store management and verified expiry receipt
rule: Canceling payment ≠ deleting child data automatically
error: Play unavailable; mismatch; paid until date
accept: Clear separate deletion and cancellation journeys.
